# Checkout Footer

Matches the footer block on hosted checkout success and error pages.

## Preview

<CheckoutFooterDemo />

## Installation

<Installation name="checkout-footer" />

## Usage

```tsx
import { CheckoutFooter } from '@/components/lomi-ui/checkout-footer';

<CheckoutFooter
  termsHref="https://lomi.africa/terms?from=checkout"
  privacyHref="https://lomi.africa/privacy?from=checkout"
/>;
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ----------- |
| `termsHref` | `string` | Terms link URL. |
| `privacyHref` | `string` | Privacy link URL. |
| `logoSrc` | `string` | lomi logo path. Defaults to `/company/lomi_l.webp`. |
| `logoAlt` | `string` | Logo alt text. |
